_comment: Shared test vectors for the prompt policy. Read by ios/Packages/AppCore ContentPolicyTests and _shared/policy_test.ts, so client and server stay in lock-step. operation defaults to magic_edit; expected is a PolicyCategory raw value or null (allowed). Every vector runs against all languages' lists together, as in production. words: what words() returns for a text (control characters dropped), so both sides normalise alike.
